title: Amazing Yeasty Canadian Rye Bread Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot Canadian dish featuring yeasty rye bread, this stew is perfect for a cold winter's night, and is sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, brown the ground beef over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onions to the pot and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine with the beef and onions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the beef broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, then pour the mixture over the beef and vegetables in the pot.
Add the cubed rye bread to the pot, stirring to combine with the other ingredients.
Sprinkle the active dry yeast over the top of the stew and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
